Zotero MCP server built around a **preview-first, journaled write model**: an agent's proposed change is previewed and reversible, never a silent library mutation, and a `zotero://capabilities` resource declares exactly what's read-only vs. write. Reads run keyless against the local Zotero desktop API; writes and group libraries use a Web API key. The default tool surface stays small — `context`, `search`, `sql`, plus a `command_search`/`command_run` facade that drives the same CLI a human uses (set `ZOTIO_MCP_SURFACE=mirror` for one tool per command).

Install — `zotio-mcp` ships with the CLI (`brew install orgmentem/tap/zotio`, or unpack a [release](https://github.com/OrgMentem/zotio/releases) archive):

- **Claude Code:** `claude mcp add zotero zotio-mcp -e ZOTERO_API_KEY=<your-key>`
- **Claude Desktop:** download the per-platform `.mcpb` from [releases](https://github.com/OrgMentem/zotio/releases) and double-click
- **Other MCP hosts** (Cursor, Cline, Codex, opencode…):
  ```json
  { "mcpServers": { "zotero": { "command": "zotio-mcp", "env": { "ZOTERO_API_KEY": "<your-key>" } } } }
  ```

`ZOTERO_API_KEY` is optional — read-only local-desktop use is keyless, but writes are via web and require the key.
